description: This file implements network argument handling for the starboard platform, including socket creation, waiting for client connections, and reading data from sockets.

methods.name: CreateListenSocket
methods.description: Creates and binds a TCP socket to listen for incoming connections on a specified port and IP version.

methods.name: WaitUntilReadableOrConnectionReset
methods.description: Waits until the socket is readable or the connection is reset.

methods.name: WaitForClientConnection
methods.description: Waits for a client to connect within a specified timeout period.

methods.name: SplitStringByLines
methods.description: Splits a string buffer into lines based on newline characters.

methods.name: NetArgsWaitForPayload
methods.description: Sets up a listening socket, waits for a client, receives data, and returns the data split into lines.
